title: See Moments After a Glacier Collapsed, Launching Deadly Flash Floods in Nepal
summary_full: Exclusive videos verified by The New York Times show the clearest view yet of the avalanche in northern Nepal near Tibet that sent a wall of water and mud coursing through river valleys below.
